name: Personal Push Backend
objective: Add a minimal private Cloudflare Worker + D1 API and upload only push/reminder data while exercises and routines remain local.
exit_criteria: A separate Worker project is configured for D1, strict CORS, and encrypted secret bindings without checked-in secrets.
D1 stores only device credentials, push subscription fields, and the minimal reminder schedule; exercises and routines are never uploaded.
Pairing, authenticated subscription, schedule, status, and revoke flows validate input and reject unauthorized requests.
The client uploads a push subscription and minimal schedule only after explicit user action, with runtime device credentials kept out of source and build variables.
Backend and client tests cover happy paths, invalid input, authorization failures, CORS, token handling, and local-first preservation.
Step 4 push delivery and Cron sending remain unimplemented and are clearly documented as a later phase.
